summary: Iteration 4 E2E testing of profile photo + socials/about + daily reminder flag, Daily Challenge card and rewards, admin daily-reminders runner, Companies list + detail + chips. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests pass (added 15 new tests covering avatar upload/get/remove, non-image & >3MB rejection, socials/about/reminder persistence + invalid-host + non-https rejection, daily guest vs logged-in payloads, fresh-user daily submit -> {streak:1, coins_earned:10, badge:null}, admin daily-reminders/run returns {sent:n} for admin and 403 for non-admin, companies list guest vs authed, company detail with byDifficulty, 404 for unknown company). Frontend: logged-in home shows daily-challenge with daily-streak/daily-coins and either daily-solve-button or daily-completed; guest shows the global pick; nav-companies-link -> /companies grid (12 companies, company-card-google), companies-search-input filters, Google -> /companies/Google shows company-name/company-progress (authed only)/company-problems; unknown company shows company-error; problem detail two-sum shows 6 company chips with company-chip-<name> hrefs /companies/<Name>; profile page shows profile-daily-streak, profile-coins, avatar-upload-button; avatar-file-input upload of PNG triggers 'Profile photo updated' toast and surfaces avatar-remove-button; edit profile dialog saves profile-about + profile-socials (social-link-github with target=_blank, social-link-twitter) and persists daily-reminder-switch; invalid social (https://evil.com/x in github) shows error toast and backend returns 400; avatar-remove-button successfully removes the picture; For You section stays inside viewport width (no horizontal overflow).
critical_code_review_comments: Guest DailyChallenge card renders a daily-solve-button that links to /problems/<slug>. The spec said guest should see a 'sign-in hint' instead. Currently guests can still open the problem (which works fine as code runs for guests), but the sign-in nudge from the spec is absent. Minor UX gap only - not blocking.

DailyController.sendReminders @Scheduled cron '0 0 14 * * *' is in UTC; the review request says '~7:30 PM IST' which would be 14:00 UTC. The exact spec minute (30) differs from the comment but the cron fires at 14:00 UTC (= 19:30 IST). The admin manual /api/admin/daily-reminders/run also updates daily_reminded_date, so running it manually will suppress the automatic 14:00 UTC send for the same day - intended by design.

Spring servlet's multipart limit returns 413 for >3MB uploads before the controller's own 400 'Image must be under 3 MB' check runs. Both statuses are rejections but the user-facing toast text may differ. Consider aligning (either lifting Spring's limit above 3MB so controller's 400 message is used, or returning a nicer error message from the Spring exception handler).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Important: (a) delivered@resend.dev user has daily_reminder=true and already completed today's challenge (trapping-rain-water) with streak=1, coins=10. To test streak growth you need to register a fresh user and submit their daily. (b) Companies response for a guest returns solved=0 for every company; auth header is required to see solved counts. (c) /companies/<Name> is case-sensitive (Google works, google does not). (d) To test logged-in UI, inject localStorage.cl_token after visiting /problems to avoid /login redirect; the Sign-in page uses provider buttons and 'Email & password' must be clicked first to reveal auth-email-input. (e) Spring returns 413 (not 400) for avatar uploads >3MB because Spring's multipart.max-file-size kicks in first. (f) Social URL validation requires https:// and the exact allowed host for each provider; github with https://evil.com returns 400 with message 'Invalid github link'.
